name: app-design-system
title_zh: Material 3 与 Apple HIG 双轨合
tagline_zh: 画界面时不再纠结该听 Google 还是 Apple——它把两套规范、UX 心理学。
tagline_en: Stop choosing between Google and Apple—this skill merges both specs, UX psychology, accessibility, and enterprise.
desc_en: Nguyên tắc thiết kế ứng dụng chuyên nghiệp kết hợp Material Design 3, Apple HIG, tâm lý học UX, Enterprise UX, dashboard và accessibility. Dùng khi thiết kế app, web app, dashboard, SaaS tool, admin panel, form phức tạp, data table, hoặc bất kỳ giao diện ứng dụng nào. Cũng dùng khi được hỏi về UX/UI best practices, design system, responsive design, accessibility.
why_zh: 不是堆规范条文，而是把冲突处（如导航、密度）按场景裁决，并附上为什么——像有位资深设计评审坐在旁边。
why_en: It doesn't pile up spec quotes—it adjudicates conflicts (nav, density) by context with rationale, like a senior design reviewer.
limit_zh: 只输出设计建议和原则，不生成代码、不画图、不产出设计稿文件；需要你已有具体界面或组件描述。
limit_en: Advice only—no code, no mockups, no design files. Needs your concrete UI/component description. No motion details or bespoke brand visual.
title_en: A dual-track UI design rulebook merging Material 3 & Apple.
